# @ndigo/factory

IoC factory with scopes, lifecycle, and aware processors for Ndigo

Version-matched export index for the installed package. Read `README.md`
for usage; the workspace guide index ships with `@ndigo/cli` as
`assets/agent/docs-index.md`.

## Public exports

- `$aware`
- `Aware` *(type)* — An interface indicating that a value is eligible to be notified by the factory of a particular framework object through a callback-style method. The actual met…
- `NameAware` *(type)* — Interface to be implemented by values that want to be aware of their value name in a factory.
- `AsAware` — Mixin marking a class as aware: adds a `true` value under the `Aware` symbol key so the factory can recognise aware instances without a concrete interface.
- `AsNameAware` — Mixin adding a mutable `name` property to a class.
- `likeAware` — Determines whether or not the `value` provided is Aware.
- `likeAwareAnd` — Builds a predicate that tests whether a value is Aware and matches the given `predicate`.
- `likeNameAware` — Returns whether a value is NameAware.
- `ContextToken` — A type-safe key used for value registration and retrieval in a `Registry`.
- `isContextToken` — Determines whether or not the `value` is a ContextToken.
- `InitializationAwareProcessor` *(type)* — Processor applied to every instance the factory creates, before and after initialization callbacks run. Each hook receives the entry name and instance and retu…
- `ConstructionAwareProcessor` *(type)* — Processor that participates in the construction phase: before construction (suppressing or replacing default construction), after construction (before property…
- `DestructionAwareProcessor` *(type)* — Factory hook that allows for custom modification of new instances, e.g. checking for marker interfaces or wrapping them with proxies.
- `EntryRegistryProcessor` *(type)* — Factory hook that allows for modification of an application context's values.
- `FactoryPostProcessor` *(type)* — Factory hook that allows for custom modification of new instances, e.g. checking for marker interfaces or wrapping them with proxies.
- `EntryProcessor` *(type)* — A union type representing all possible entry processor interfaces.
- `likeInitializationAwareProcessor` — Determines whether or not the `value` provided participates in initialization.
- `likeConstructionAwareProcessor` — Determines whether or not the `value` provided participates in construction.
- `likeDestructionAwareProcessor` — Determines whether or not the `value` provided is a DestructionAwareProcessor.
- `likeEntryRegistryProcessor` — Determines whether or not the `value` provided is an EntryRegistryProcessor.
- `likeEntryProcessor` — Determines whether or not the `value` provided is an EntryProcessor.
- `Factory` *(type)* — The minimal container contract: `getInstance` resolves a registered name to its value, instantiating constructors and returning registered instances and primit…
- `HierarchicalFactory` *(type)* — Extends Factory to provide hierarchical factory capabilities.
- `ConfigurableFactory` *(type)* — Extends HierarchicalFactory and Registry to provide configurable factory capabilities.
- `FactoryAware` *(type)* — Interface to be implemented by values that wish to be aware of their owning Factory.
- `AsFactoryAware` — A mixin that adds FactoryAware capabilities to a class.
- `likeFactory` — Determines whether or not the `value` provided is a Factory.
- `likeFactoryAware` — Determines whether or not the `value` provided is FactoryAware.
- `likeHierarchicalFactory` — Determines whether or not the `value` provided is HierarchicalFactory.
- `likeConfigurableFactory` — Determines whether or not the `value` provided is ConfigurableFactory.
- `AbstractFactory` — An abstract base class for implementing a ConfigurableFactory and ScopedFactory.
- `DefaultFactory`
- `ProxiedFactory` — A factory that uses a Proxy to allow direct property access for value manipulation.
- `Destroyable` *(type)* — A value whose resources are released permanently.
- `AsyncDestroyable` *(type)* — A Destroyable whose destruction is asynchronous.
- `Initializable` *(type)* — A value with a one-shot `init()` hook.
- `Lifecycle` *(type)* — A component with an explicit, reversible start/stop lifecycle.
- `Phased` *(type)* — A component that runs in a numeric startup phase.
- `ManagedLifecycle` *(type)* — A Lifecycle the container drives automatically: started in ascending phase order on context refresh, stopped in descending phase order on close.
- `LifecycleCoordinator` *(type)* — Drives registered ManagedLifecycle targets on context refresh and close.
- `likeDestroyable` — Narrows a value to the Destroyable shape.
- `likeInitializable` — Narrows a value to the Initializable shape.
- `likeLifecycle` — Narrows a value to the Lifecycle shape.
- `likePhased` — Narrows a value to the Phased shape.
- `likeManagedLifecycle` — Narrows a value to the ManagedLifecycle shape.
- `DefaultLifecycleCoordinator` — Default LifecycleCoordinator: on refresh starts auto-startup targets in ascending phase order; on close stops running targets in descending phase order.
- `Registry` *(type)* — Interface that defines a registry for shared instances.
- `likeRegistry` — Narrows a value to the Registry shape.

- `KnownScope` *(type)* — Scope names shipped by the factory.
- `PossibleScope` *(type)* — Any scope name: a KnownScope or a custom registered scope.
- `ObjectFactory` *(type)* — Lazy factory callback invoked by a scope when it needs to create a value.
- `Scope` *(type)* — A caching strategy: resolves named values through the supplied object factory and can destroy cached values.
- `ScopedFactory` *(type)* — A factory that exposes named Scope strategies and destroys scoped values.
- `defineScope` — Defines scope metadata on a class
- `getScope` — Retrieves scope metadata from a class or instance
- `hasScope` — Checks if target has scope metadata
- `scope` — TC39 decorator for defining scope on a class
- `singletonScope` — Decorator for singleton scope (convenience factory)
- `prototypeScope` — Decorator for prototype scope (convenience factory)
- `hashScope` — Decorator for hash/route scope (convenience factory): one cached instance per active scope key (`HashScope.setCurrentKey`), torn down when the route ends (`Has…
- `refreshScope` — Decorator for refresh scope (convenience factory): the instance cache is cleared when the environment refreshes (`config:refresh`), so the next `getValue` re-c…
- `PrototypeScope` — Prototype scope implementation — creates a fresh instance on every `getValue()` call.
- `HashScope` — Hash (route) scope implementation — one instance per scope key. Activate a scope context by calling `setCurrentKey(key)` before `getValue()`.
- `SingletonScope` — Singleton scope implementation — creates at most one instance per named value. Destruction callbacks can be registered when an instance is created.
